answer: Admission is staged. A new key first parks on an island queue and may enter the vote set only through one inlet: it posts a 40-token refundable lock for a full epoch and attaches a compact work receipt the chain can re-execute. While the lock is live, any established agent can file a whisper challenge; if the receipt fails replay, the lock is forfeited to the challenger and that key is barred. Cloning identities therefore multiplies locked capital and exposure rather than cheap votes.
